selection: Aider Polyglot's 225 exercises are the hardest of Exercism's tracks, picked because most models failed them; a 9B model would fail nearly all, which compares nothing.
Languages: Python and JavaScript, the toolchains the bench needs no extra setup for (go, rust, java and cmake for C++ aren't assumed).
Ranked by the reference solution's non-blank lines; taken from the smaller end (Python up to 41, JavaScript up to 75).

Left out despite their size: search and constraint puzzles (book-store, dominoes, zebra-puzzle, two-bucket, alphametics, connect, killer-sudoku-helper), padding-rule traps (transpose), long lyric generation (beer-song) and async/concurrency exercises (promises, parallel-letter-frequency).
`npm run validate-cases` checks every case: the stub fails its tests and the reference solution passes them all.
